fidelityCritique: The machine-authoritative deterministic fidelity result passed all probes; this independent review does not override that result.
Telemetry convincingly evidences immediate play, attacks landing on the named HEX-FRAME TITAN amid nine threats, stat-changing salvage upgrades, and both EXTRACT/DESCEND risk-reward outcomes.

However, the supplied screenshots only show an enlarged Core HUD crop, not score/salvage or progress regions. More seriously, the second frame reads CORE 106 / 120 while its cyan health bar appears completely full, making the visible Core-state presentation internally contradictory. MH-04 is therefore not convincingly recognizable from the supplied visual evidence.
critique: Both captures are dominated by a single oversized HUD panel and a sparse dark grid; no player, Titan, drones, projectiles, forge, salvage, or extraction decision is visible.

The cyan-on-navy palette has appropriate sci-fi intent and the grid provides a faint background layer, but the frame lacks the neon silhouettes, environmental life, and combat effects needed for a polished cyberpunk arena.
The CORE label and numerals are highly legible, but the 106 / 120 readout conflicts with a visually full health bar in the second screenshot.
The stills do not communicate the current combat state or playable objective; engagement is supported by telemetry score progression and verified events rather than visible feedback.
Performance is excellent: session metrics report 61 FPS, with 60 FPS in the captured telemetry snapshots.
priorityFixes: Correct the Core-bar fill calculation so its visible length precisely reflects current/max Core, then capture full-canvas gameplay frames that also show distinct Score/Salvage and Progress HUD regions.
Reframe automated screenshots to include the player, HEX-FRAME TITAN, smaller threats/projectiles, and a cannon impact or damage reaction rather than an isolated HUD close-up.
Increase arena readability and spectacle with clearly visible forge/salvage shards, cyan-orange hit bursts, drifting sparks, and stronger foreground/background separation.
